title: The PRL 2.5 m telescope and its first-light instruments FOC and PARAS-2
what_was_studied: Telescope integration, fibre feed and initial PARAS-2 configuration
numerical_result: PARAS-2 operates over about 380 to 690 nm at resolving power near 107000 to 110000
remaining_question: Instrument specification is not a stable-star precision result

title: PARAS-2 radial velocity measurements of evolved stars
what_was_studied: On-sky standard-star sequence and inter-fibre drift
numerical_result: A standard star showed 2.65 m/s daily dispersion over 37 observations in 35 days; off-sky inter-fibre drift was 0.20 to 0.50 m/s
remaining_question: The two statistics have different light paths and must not be substituted for one another

title: Design and development of the Cassegrain module for PARAS-2 spectrograph
numerical_result: The May 2026 paper describes a current coupling-system development and is a preprint
remaining_question: Its effect on held-out stellar RVs has not yet been established

title: Physical Research Laboratory annual report 2024 to 2025
what_was_studied: Double scrambler and detector cooling development
numerical_result: The report describes resolving power near 110000 and a liquid-nitrogen detector target of minus 120 plus or minus 0.1 degrees Celsius with about 20-hour hold time
remaining_question: Engineering targets require later on-sky validation across complete nights
